description: This file defines the SystemUserController class within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It extends a base controller, uses traits to include user-related services, and sets up a Vue component for displaying or managing system users, specifically by preparing a 'system-user-list' component with undeletable user IDs.

classes.name: SystemUserController
classes.description: Controller for managing system user interfaces, extending base Vue controller functionality, and preparing user-related components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by creating a 'system-user-list' component and adding a prop with undeletable user IDs obtained from the user service.
